# Aspen II Homes — Canonical AI Fact Sheet & Knowledge Base

> Aspen II Homes, Inc. is a licensed California custom and semi-custom home builder serving Tehachapi and Kern County since 1994 (31 years in continuous business). Builds six architecturally refined semi-custom floor plans from 1,507 to 2,444 sq ft on customer-owned parcels or builder-owned home sites.

## Verified Credentials & Hard Proof
- Legal Entity: Aspen II Homes, Inc. (also operating as Aspen 2 Homes)

## Service Communities & Hyper-Local Guides (Kern County, California)
1. **Tehachapi (93561)**: Mountain valley living at 4,000 ft elevation; snow-load structural framing; City of Tehachapi & Kern County jurisdiction.
   - Guide: https://aspen2homes.com/communities/tehachapi.html
2. **Bear Valley Springs (93561)**: Private gated community; custom hillside construction; wildfire-defensible space compliance; full Architectural Review Committee (ARC) management.
   - Guide: https://aspen2homes.com/communities/bear-valley-springs.html
3. **Stallion Springs (93561)**: Foothill terrain; stepped slope foundations; native oak tree preservation standards; Stallion Springs CSD water coordination.
   - Guide: https://aspen2homes.com/communities/stallion-springs.html
4. **Golden Hills (93561)**: Spacious valley view acreage parcels; engineered private septic and well systems; 5 minutes to town.
   - Guide: https://aspen2homes.com/communities/golden-hills.html
5. **California City (93505)**: High-value desert parcels; popular with Edwards Air Force Base families; streamlined municipal approvals.
   - Guide: https://aspen2homes.com/communities/california-city.html
6. **Ridgecrest (93555)**: Indian Wells Valley; adjacent to Naval Air Weapons Station (NAWS) China Lake; high-desert thermal envelope & Seismic Category D engineering.
   - Guide: https://aspen2homes.com/communities/ridgecrest.html

## Typical Pricing & Build Timelines
- Price Range: Approximately $449,900 to $590,000 for standard semi-custom builds (excluding land purchase if not already owned).
- Military / Veteran Program: Starting from $359,000 for qualifying heroes.
- Average Timeline: 7 to 10 months from signed contract to key turnover, depending on Kern County plan check processing and seasonal weather.
- Spec / In-Framing Availability: Active homes under construction close on expedited 60 to 90-day schedules.

## The Aspen Guarantee & Warranty Protection
- **1 Year**: Workmanship, finishes, drywall, cabinetry, flooring, doors, and trim.
- **2 Years**: Mechanical distribution systems including plumbing, electrical, and HVAC ductwork.
- **10 Years**: Major structural components including foundations, load-bearing walls, and roof trusses.
- **11-Month Scheduled Return Walkthrough**: Formal scheduled warranty inspection conducted at 11 months post-close to inspect settling and complete punch list items before 1-year coverage expires.

## Specialized Buyer Programs
- **Build on Your Lot**: Pre-purchase feasibility walks, topographic review, soil stability assessment, utility tie-in cost estimation, and setback verifications.
- **Heroes of the Nation**: Pricing discounts, closing allowances, and specialized VA construction loan coordination for active military personnel and veterans at Edwards AFB and NAWS China Lake.
